_doc: vLLM serving template: single GPU, TP=1. Tuned for the shared-GPU host (pinned to CUDA device 1 by default). Model-agnostic — pair with any harness; the harness's model.name tells vllm what to serve. Engine knobs are consumed by backend/vllm/serve.sh via scripts/load_backend_env.py; each can be overridden with the matching env var (e.g. MAX_MODEL_LEN=65536 make serve). `preset` maps to the case statement in serve.sh.
